highlight.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Enter Technical Preview
highlight.summary: GitHub launched Agentic Workflows allowing developers to automate repository tasks using AI agents within GitHub Actions. Write workflows in plain Markdown instead of complex YAML, and let AI handle intelligent decision-making for issue triage, pull request reviews, and repository maintenance.

resources.title: VS Code 1.123: AI-Native with 1M Token Context
resources.why_now: <cite index="21-11,21-12">Support for 1M context windows for Anthropic and OpenAI models with automatically synced chat sessions across machines</cite> makes VS Code the first editor to truly handle massive codebases through AI assistance.

resources.title: Windows 11 Gets Developer-Focused CLI Tools
resources.why_now: <cite index="4-22,4-24">Coreutils for Windows brings Linux-style command-line utilities directly to Windows 11, based on the open-source uutils project</cite> and <cite index="4-15,4-16">Intelligent Terminal integrates AI agents directly into the terminal experience for context-aware assistance</cite>.

resources.title: Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex: The CLI Agent Showdown
resources.why_now: <cite index="8-6,8-8">OpenAI shipped a Codex refresh on GPT-5.5 that several recent rankings now put at #1, while Claude Code moved to Opus 4.7</cite> and <cite index="8-14,8-16">OpenCode crossed 150K GitHub stars supporting 75+ LLM endpoints out of the box</cite>.

resources.title: GitHub Actions Gets Parallel Steps & Security Overhaul
resources.why_now: <cite index="13-8,13-9">GitHub will start work on parallel steps, one of the most requested features, with plans to ship before mid-2026</cite> while <cite index="14-8,14-23">new repos default to read-only permissions with tighter security defaults</cite> addressing supply chain attacks.

claude_take: The developer tooling landscape in 2026 centers around AI-native workflows that blur the lines between writing code and orchestrating agents. The most significant shift is tools like VS Code and GitHub Actions evolving from code editors and CI/CD platforms into agent orchestration environments where developers describe intent in natural language rather than imperative YAML or complex configurations.
